clue.text: Create party discord? Yes, as far as I'm concerned

parts.note: to create something is to form it

indicators.note: discord means disagreement and disorder, so the letters of party are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone asked whether to stir up trouble at a party says yes, personally speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark and 'Yes' frame it as a reply; 'discord' scrambles the party's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning speaking personally or from one's own point of view.

clue.text: One half of a Western stage partnership

definitions.text: One half of a Western stage partnership

parts.words: One half of a Western stage partnership
parts.note: Wells and his partner ran the famous stagecoach company of the American West, not a pair of actors

explanation.surface: Seems to describe one of a double act in a theatrical Western.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stage' suggests theatre, but it is the stagecoach: Wells Fargo was the stagecoach and banking company of the American West.
explanation.definitionFit: The second named founder of the Wells Fargo stagecoach company, so half the partnership.

clue.text: Decorate from top to bottom, or vice versa

indicators.text: from top to bottom, or vice versa
indicators.note: a down entry read from top to bottom or bottom to top gives the same letters, so the word is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Advice on decorating a room working downwards or upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To put new wallpaper on walls is a way to redecorate a room.

clue.text: Chay Blyth's fourth refurbished boat?

indicators.note: refurbished means done up anew, so the letters of Chay are rebuilt in another order
fourth points to the letter in fourth place of the sailor's surname

explanation.surface: Asks whether the yachtsman Chay Blyth's fourth vessel has been done up.
explanation.walkthrough: Chay Blyth is a British round-the-world yachtsman, which makes the surface apt; 'refurbished' rearranges his first name and 'fourth' picks from his surname.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing vessel used for racing or cruising, a kind of small ship.

clue.text: Infers total used is incorrect

parts.note: all means the total, the whole amount

indicators.note: incorrect means wrongly put, so the letters of used appear in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone concludes that the total amount spent has been miscalculated.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly the answer means implies; the setter uses infers loosely in that sense, and 'is incorrect' scrambles used.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs concern hinting or deducing an indirect meaning, used loosely here as synonyms.

clue.text: Entrance for vehicles

definitions.meaning: to entrance is to enrapture or carry away with delight
a collective term for the means of conveyance, buses, trains and lorries

explanation.surface: Seems to describe a gateway built for cars and lorries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance' reads as a doorway, but it is the verb meaning to delight.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrapture is one sense of the word; the other is conveyance systems collectively.

clue.text: Occupying a pre-eminent position at work

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Describes someone who holds a top role in their job.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on top of something, at the summit, is to hold the highest place.

clue.text: Giving frolicsome dog a run on the beach

indicators.note: frolicsome means playful and leaping about, so the letters of dog, a and run romp into a new order

explanation.surface: Letting a playful dog run along the beach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the beach' suggests sand, but here it means a ship stuck on the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel stranded on the shore or shallows is stuck in that state.

clue.text: Too greatly tempted, being in the red

parts.note: over as a prefix means excessively, as in overdone
drawn means attracted or lured

explanation.surface: Someone far too tempted by spending ends up in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank account showing a debit balance has had more taken out than was in it.

clue.text: Hot tip Carol may provide

indicators.note: the letters of tip and Carol may supply the answer once rearranged, so the phrase signals a reworking

explanation.surface: A woman named Carol might give a hot tip on a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may provide' rearranges TIP CAROL. 'Hot tip' reads as racing advice, but 'Hot' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Climates of the equatorial zones are typically very warm and humid.

clue.text: A sin — that's understood

parts.note: greed is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: A remark that wrongdoing has been acknowledged.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying a matter is settled by mutual consent, as an exclamation of assent.

clue.text: Father has favourite term of endearment

parts.note: pop is an informal word for a father
a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: Dad has a pet name he uses fondly.
explanation.definitionFit: A British affectionate word for a small child or a dear person, like darling.

clue.text: Issue Dad is out to advise against

indicators.note: out means not in proper order, so the letters of issue and dad are rearranged

explanation.surface: Father's warning about an issue is out to discourage someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges ISSUE DAD; 'is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: To persuade someone not to do something by giving counsel against it.

clue.text: Return journey on board jets

indicators.note: on board means aboard a ship, so the reversed journey goes inside the steamship letters

parts.note: on board suggests a ship, and SS is the abbreviation for steamship

indicators.note: return means go back, so the word for a journey is read backwards

parts.note: a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A return flight taken on board a jet aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jets' looks like aircraft but means spurts of liquid; 'Return' reverses the journey, and 'on board' is the crossword habit of putting a piece inside the steamship abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirts is a variant of spurts or squirts: sudden streams of liquid.

clue.text: Sound of contentment about course from consumer

indicators.note: about means around, so the sound of contentment surrounds the course

parts.note: a cat purrs when contented
a chase is a racecourse for steeplechasing

explanation.surface: A satisfied murmur about the menu course from a diner.
explanation.walkthrough: A steeplechase is a horse race over jumps, hence course; 'about' wraps the purr round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A buyer is someone who consumes goods, so consumer is a broad synonym.

clue.text: Catechism arranged according to plan

indicators.note: arranged means put in order, so the letters of catechism are set out afresh

explanation.surface: A religious catechism set out in a planned way.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagram drawn as an outline follows a plan or scheme, so the adjective fits.

clue.text: Kitty's back late — have a very quick check

indicators.note: back means turned the other way, so the word for the kitty is read in reverse

parts.note: a kitty is a pot of money; kitty's read as kitty is, plural pots
the late are the dead, as in the late king

explanation.surface: The cat came home late, so check on it quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns POTS into STOP. 'check' means to halt, not to inspect.
explanation.definitionFit: To halt abruptly is a check to motion that happens instantly.

clue.text: Break one's nose, like Gill

definitions.meaning: a short rest or pause from work
a nose or a fish's gill is an organ for taking in air

explanation.surface: Someone called Gill breaks her nose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gill' reads as a woman's name, but it is the fish's organ.
explanation.definitionFit: A rest pause from exertion; also anything that inhales, such as an organ for respiration.

clue.text: Nimbleness of soldier in Italy on manoeuvres

indicators.note: in means the soldier is placed inside the other letters
manoeuvres are military exercises with movement, so the letters of Italy shift about

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier showing agility on military exercises in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on manoeuvres' scrambles Italy, and 'in' puts the American soldier among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Quickness and lightness in movement is a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Restoration novel in authentic setting

indicators.note: a setting holds a jewel, so authentic surrounds the novel word like a mount

parts.note: authentic means real
novel as an adjective means new

explanation.surface: Could be a novel of the Restoration period in an authentic historical setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' reads as a book but is the adjective; 'setting' mounts it within the authentic word.
explanation.definitionFit: Making something as good as new again is a restoring of it.

clue.text: Drinking a great deal of the best gin cocktail

parts.note: top means the best, as in top quality

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters of gin are mixed up

explanation.surface: Downing plenty of a premium gin cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' rearranges GIN into ING.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is to drink alcohol heavily and habitually.

clue.text: Classical admission of guilt

parts.note: a Latin confession meaning I have sinned, Latin being the classical language

explanation.surface: Describes an old confession of wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin word meaning I have sinned, used as a humorous confession.

clue.text: Yet he stands at the head of the board

definitions.text: Yet he stands at the head of the board

parts.words: Yet he stands at the head of the board
parts.note: the joke is that the person leading a board meeting is named after a seat, yet is said to stand

explanation.surface: Remarks on the person standing at the head of the table.
explanation.walkthrough: His title contains the word for a seat, so the 'Yet' is the joke: he stands though named for sitting.
explanation.definitionFit: The person presiding over a company's board of directors.

clue.text: It may be of untold value

definitions.text: It may be of untold value

parts.words: It may be of untold value
parts.note: untold reads as immeasurable but means not revealed, which is the whole point of confidential information

explanation.surface: Seems to describe a priceless treasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'untold' seems to mean immense but means not told.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept hidden from others is by nature not told.

clue.text: Scour the outback

definitions.meaning: to rub hard so as to clean
Australian term for brushwood country or remote bush land

explanation.surface: An instruction to search the Australian bush thoroughly.
explanation.walkthrough: The outback is the remote Australian interior; low stunted vegetation there is called this.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a verb meaning to clean by rubbing and a noun for land covered in stunted trees.

clue.text: Record-making competitor

definitions.meaning: making a record, as an item written in a register or ledger

explanation.surface: A competitor sets a new record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record-making' suggests breaking a record, but it is writing a record in a book.
explanation.definitionFit: An item written into a log, and also a person or thing entered in a competition.

clue.text: Help to ensure a ship is on time

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: Aid to make sure a vessel sails punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: To aid someone is to give them support, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Guarantee to be careful about wild speech

indicators.note: about means around, so careful wraps the wild speech

parts.note: wary means careful or cautious
a rant is a wild, impassioned speech

explanation.surface: A guarantee to watch what you say in a tirade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild speech' is a single piece, a tirade; 'about' wraps careful round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A written assurance that goods will be repaired or replaced if faulty.

clue.text: City of Paris?

parts.note: Paris here is the prince of Greek legend whose abduction of Helen started the war, not the French capital

explanation.surface: Asks which city Paris belongs to.
explanation.walkthrough: Paris is not the French capital but the Trojan prince who took Helen.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient city ruled by King Priam, father of the prince in the Iliad.

clue.text: Band leader in hurry to become a big name

indicators.note: in places the band's first letter inside the word for hurry

parts.note: celerity means swiftness or haste

indicators.note: a leader is at the front, so only the opening letter of band is used

explanation.surface: The leader of a band rushing to become famous.
explanation.walkthrough: Celerity is a formal word for speed; 'leader' takes the band's first letter, and 'in' puts it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous person is commonly called a well-known name, so star is the sense.
